sous_titre: Croissance annuelle moyenne des examens, en %, de 2014 à 2023, grand réseau hospitalier américain

IRM.texte: The average annual increases by modality were 14.5% for MRI

Scanner.texte: The average annual increases by modality were 14.5% for MRI, 14.4% for CT

Échographie.texte: The average annual increases by modality were 14.5% for MRI, 14.4% for CT, and 10.7% for US.
